mapper.select: SELECT g.`id`, g.`goods_name`, g.`goods_title`, g.`goods_img`, g.`goods_detail`, g.`goods_price`, g.`goods_stock`, sg.`seckill_price`, sg.`stock_count`, sg.`start_date`, sg.`end_date` FROM t_goods g LEFT JOIN t_seckill_goods sg ON g.id = sg.goods_id

SELECT g.`id`, g.`goods_name`, g.`goods_title`, g.`goods_img`, g.`goods_detail`, g.`goods_price`, g.`goods_stock`, sg.`seckill_price`, sg.`stock_count`, sg.`start_date`, sg.`end_date` FROM t_goods AS g LEFT JOIN t_seckill_goods AS sg ON g.id = sg.goods_id WHERE g.id=#{goodsId} -- goodsId,是id属性指定的方法(findGoodsVoByGoodsId)的形参名
